newsitem.title: CROATIA: Ailing president to return in 2 days - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Ailing president to return in 2 days - doctor.

text.p: President Franjo Tudjman, who is being treated at a U.S. military hospital near Washington, will return to Croatia on Friday, his private doctor said on Wednesday.
"After receiving treatment President Tudjman will leave Walter Reed hospital in two days to return home," doctor Branimir Jaksic told the state television news in a live broadcast from Washington.
The state-controlled television said it was barred from filming Tudjman or his hospital room for security reasons.
United States officials said last week that Tudjman was seriously ill with stomach cancer. But Croatian state media continues to report that the 74-year old leader suffers from "digestion problems".
Croatia's opposition parties and independent newspapers have accused state media of reverting to communist methods by shrouding Tudjman's illness in secrecy.
